policies.title: Belarusian ordinary passports: Nigeria tourism eVisa
policies.summary: Nigeria Immigration Service's current F5A tourism service covers Belarus, issues the visa certificate by email before travel, and separately assigns Belarus a payable single-entry fee.
conditions: Use a Belarusian ordinary/biometric citizen passport. The issuer's current Government page distinguishes that citizen passport from diplomatic and service passports.

F5A is tourism only, single entry and up to 30 days. Apply online, upload the stated documents and pay before travel; the visa certificate is sent by email, so this is electronic issuance rather than an arrival visa.

F5A generally excepts ECOWAS States and countries with visa-abolition/waiver agreements. Belarus is not an ECOWAS State, and Appendix I's payable Belarus single-entry fee directly supports use of the F5A route. Purpose, document, carrier and final-admission requirements remain separate.

application.label: Nigeria Immigration Service eVisa portal
steps: Apply online with the Belarusian ordinary passport and stated tourism documents.
Pay the visa fee and obtain the visa certificate by email before departure.
Present the issued visa for carrier and final-admission checks.

policies.title: Belarusian ordinary passports: Equatorial Guinea electronic visitor visa
policies.summary: Equatorial Guinea's Government-authenticated live eVisa service accepts all nationalities using a regular passport and sends the eVisa by email/PDF before travel.
conditions: Use the Belarusian ordinary/biometric citizen passport used for travel; the live service excludes non-regular travel documents, while Belarus separately issues diplomatic and service passports.
Register, upload visitor documents, pay online and obtain the eVisa by email/PDF before travel. This is electronic issuance, not a visa on arrival.
Purpose, passport validity, health, entry-point, carrier and final-admission requirements remain separate.

application.label: Equatorial Guinea eVisa application (VFS)
steps: Register using the Belarusian ordinary passport for travel.
Pay and receive the issued eVisa by email/PDF before travel.
Carry the issued record for final immigration processing.
